item.question: Zainab started colouring at 04:25 p.m. and stopped at 05:10 p.m. (a) How long did she colour? Then: (b) How long is it from 07:20 a.m. to 10:50 a.m.?
steps: (a) Hop to the next whole hour. 04:25 p.m. to 05:00 p.m. is 60 − 25 = 35 minutes.
05:00 p.m. to 05:10 p.m. is 10 minutes.
35 + 10 = 45 minutes, so Zainab coloured for 45 minutes.
(b) Hop whole hours first. 07:20 a.m. to 10:20 a.m. is 10 − 7 = 3 hours.
So the time from 07:20 a.m. to 10:50 a.m. is 3 hours 30 minutes.
Check: 07:20 a.m. plus 3 hours is 10:20 a.m., and 10:20 a.m. plus 30 minutes is 10:50 a.m.

item.question: Zainab took 1 hour 50 minutes, Remo took 1 hour 25 minutes and Mary took 2 hours 5 minutes to finish a puzzle. Who took the longest time and who took the least?
steps: Compare the hours first. Zainab has 1 hour, Remo has 1 hour and Mary has 2 hours.
Mary has the most hours, so Mary took the longest time.
Zainab and Remo have the same hours, so compare their minutes.
25 minutes is less than 50 minutes, so Remo took less time than Zainab. Remo took the least time.
Check in minutes: Zainab 60 + 50 = 110, Remo 60 + 25 = 85 and Mary 120 + 5 = 125.
125 is the most and 85 is the least, so Mary is the longest and Remo is the least.

item.question: (a) Write 07:45 p.m. in the 24-hour format. (b) Write 16:20 hours in the 12-hour format.
steps: (a) 07:45 p.m. is a p.m. time, so add 12 to the hour.
The minutes stay 45, so 07:45 p.m. is 19:45 hours.
(b) 16 is more than 12, so it is a p.m. time. Take 12 away from the hour.
The minutes stay 20, so 16:20 hours is 04:20 p.m.
Check: going back, 4 + 12 = 16 and 19 − 12 = 7, so both answers match.
item.text:

1. (a) 07:45 p.m. is a p.m. time, so add 12 to the hour.
2. 7 + 12 = 19.
3. The minutes stay 45, so 07:45 p.m. is 19:45 hours.
4. (b) 16 is more than 12, so it is a p.m. time. Take 12 away from the hour.
5. 16 − 12 = 4.
6. The minutes stay 20, so 16:20 hours is 04:20 p.m.
7. Check: going back, 4 + 12 = 16 and 19 − 12 = 7, so both answers match.
Answer: (a) 19:45 hours (b) 04:20 p.m.

item.question: In a race, Remo's time is 01:48 and Zainab's time is 01:52, in minutes and seconds. Read each time. Who won, and by how many seconds? Change Remo's time to seconds.
steps: 01:48 means 1 minute 48 seconds. 01:52 means 1 minute 52 seconds.
Both took 1 minute, so compare the seconds. 48 is less than 52.
The least time wins, so Remo won.
52 − 48 = 4 seconds, so Remo won by 4 seconds.
1 minute = 60 seconds, so 1 minute 48 seconds = 60 + 48 = 108 seconds.
Check: Zainab's 1 minute 52 seconds is 60 + 52 = 112 seconds, and 112 − 108 = 4 seconds.
item.answer: Remo won by 4 seconds. His time, 1 minute 48 seconds, is 108 seconds
